stations.label: Commander
stations.notes: Officer; front cab beside the driver. Receives designations from the battery PU-12 by radio and gives the orders. The АПУ controls here are SAM3D placements (their real seat isn't known); power is the driver's (PU-303, rwd_mb3).

stations.label: Deputy commander
stations.notes: Launch console (key, ПУСК ГОТОВ, missile selection), elevation wheel and dial, TV monitor. Control ids keep SAM Simulator's 'fo.' (Firing Officer) prefix.

stations.label: Senior operator
stations.notes: Search radar (SOC) scope, IFF, azimuth wheel: puts the target under the SSC azimuth line.

stations.label: Operator
stations.notes: Range indicator and range wheel; SSC transmitter and capture (ТСЦ). The NVA senior operator also sets the range mark on the search scope; SAM3D has one range wheel, so it is the operator's (sam3d).

stations.label: Driver
stations.notes: Front cab. Works the power supply: the power-supply control panel PU-303 is at his left (rwd_mb3).

launch.notes: Restarts: after a launch ПУСК ГОТОВ goes out and lights again when the next missile can be launched (p30). The manual gives no time; SAM3D repeats missile preparation (the 15 s spin-up), confidence estimate.

tuning.source: r123m_training (selecting a fixed frequency, the knobs turn by themselves until they stop; smooth tuning only at a halt, because the vibration shifts an unlocked frequency; the antenna tuned to the meter's highest reading, the lamp brightest)
tuning.notes: All four numbers are SAM3D estimates: the motors' 3 s, the antenna circuit's half-width of 5 knob divisions, a drift of 2 kHz a second on the move in smooth tuning (the net is lost within about 6 s), and the lamp at its brightest from 90 % of the peak.

subscribers.source: r124_refs (A-2 can go on a radio); r123m_training
subscribers.notes: The second box that can go on a radio; the deputy's is SAM3D's choice.
Which operator has which box is in no source found: SAM3D's choice.

subscribers.source: r124_photos (A-4 sold with A-1 and A-2)
subscribers.notes: The driver's plain box; his ВС / РС is the ПВ switch.

comms.source: r123m_training (ranges on a medium-rough route at up to 40 km/h: 4 m whip at least 20 km with the noise suppressor off and up to 13 km with it on, 1 m whip up to 8 km, emergency wire up to 4 km); r124_refs; the shouting times are SAM3D estimates
comms.notes: The range figures become losses in the receiving chain with the EM layer's plane-earth law (40 log10 of the range ratio against the 4 m whip with the suppressor off), applied to the set the headset is on. They matter only to a link made by the EM layer's radio sources. Shouting: without the commander's box, or for a crew member whose own box is on the radio, an order takes shout_quiet_s to arrive (shout_noisy_s while the turbine or the take-off generator runs): estimates, with the R-124's own specification of 90 % word intelligibility at 120 dB of noise as the reason a box is needed at all.

letter.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p150 (СМЕНА ЛИТЕРЫ — НОРМА changes the transmitter's frequency letter; ЗАХВ. АПЧ-I, -II go out and back within 1 s); mon_2112_80 (a faulty channel: КАНАЛЫ to the good one, single missiles, then СМЕНА ЛИТ.)
letter.notes: Entering СМЕНА ЛИТ. is one change. ПУСК ГОТОВ waits for the transmitters to lock again. The number of letters and what the letter does against interference are not in any source found, so the letter itself is only counted.

prep_hold.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p248 (a prepared missile is held at most 10 min, then the next is prepared; a missile can be prepared again after 10 min; three cycles, then a 1 h break); samsim_thread (ePap: the ammunition lamp flashes if the gyro overheats)
prep_hold.notes: Read as: after 10 min prepared and waiting the gyro has overheated, the lamp flashes while it rests, 10 min after each hold and 1 h after the third. The textbook doesn't say what the lamp does; the flash is the forum's.

range_sweep.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98, p120 (switch on the range indicator: the fine range sweep is driven by the target range unit at ЦЕЛЬ, or by missile channel I or II's range unit); samsim_sprites osa014-016
range_sweep.notes: Р I follows the missile of channel I, Р II that of channel II, ЦЕЛЬ the target: the fine sweep is centred on it. Where the missile is: its average speed along the flight, not a flight model.

emergency.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp150-156 (the emergency launch from the batteries: the missile flies with locked fins and climbs 24-27 s until it self-destructs; ИЗДЕЛИЯ picks the missile); samsim_thread (ePap: throws a missile off unguided)
emergency.notes: Flight time is the middle of the published 24-27 s. The throw uses no channel and no hit chance, and is not a guided launch in the debrief.

launcher.source: flak11 (NVA Osa-AK: at ВНИМАНИЕ the command transmitter comes on and two missiles are selected automatically, outer ones first, left and right; K3 about 120 m before the target); samsim_thread (creator: ЗАХВАТ about 0.8 s / 60 m after launch; ePap: the lamp sequence, К3 with УЗКИЙ ЛУЧ against a jamming target); korovin_tiv_2010 (the two missiles launched 3-5 s apart, each captured by its own wide- and medium-beam antennas); samsim_osa p30 (ПУСК ГОТОВ again for the second missile)
launcher.notes: Channel 1 = I (right launcher), 2 = II (left). 'Outer first': container 3 is taken as the outer one, from the order of the ИЗДЕЛИЯ selector (3-II ... 1-II, ОТКЛ., 1-I ... 3-I); sam3d estimate. In СОВМ. channel I fires first (sam3d estimate). medium_s and narrow_s (when СР.Л and УЗКИЙ ЛУЧ light) are sam3d estimates; min_interval_s 4 is inside Korovin's 3-5 s. The lamps stay lit as the missile goes through the beams and go out when the shot is over. nominal_flight_s only applies without the outcome model. Reloading: with tzm_alongside set and the vehicle stopped, one missile goes into an empty container every reload_s_per_missile (60 s: flak11's 6 min for six), outer containers first, only once the pair is spent and no channel is guiding; the 60 s per missile is the 6 min divided by six (the crane's three-container traverse is not modelled), the loading order is a sam3d estimate. Gyro overheating (flashing ammunition lamps) and the emergency launch are not modelled.

fuel.source: samsim_thread (ePap: about 300 l tank; turbine about 75 l/h stationary and 100 l/h moving; take-off generator about 25 l/h; half the tank is kept for driving, and the crew asks for fuel at half); voenizdat_osa_1991 p163-164 agrees (the turbine 67 kg/h, about 80 l/h, at its 50 kW; the take-off generator 20 kg/h, about 24 l/h)
fuel.notes: Burning = the power source's subsystem is not off (it burns while starting). The take-off generator is taken as 25 l/h whether or not the vehicle moves (it only runs at a halt). At the reserve the crew asks for fuel (debrief) and both power sources are cut so the rest stays for driving; this reads 'half the tank is kept for driving' as a hard limit on the power sources. refuel_lpm 60 is a sam3d estimate (no source gives a refuelling rate): a full tank from the reserve in 2.5 min.

voice.source: r124_refs; r124_bmp2 (A-1 ВЫКЛ / ВС / Р-123 / Р-112, A-2 Р-112 / ВС / Р-123: two radios; the chest switch's ВЫЗ pulls those on the radio back); r123m_training (the one on the radio leaves the intercom); mon_2112_80 (two R-123M, the R-124, a TA-57)
voice.notes: A-1 on Р-123 keeps the intercom (the chest switch's ПРМ: receive and the intercom, r124_bmp2; SAM3D as before); A-2 and the driver's ПВ on the radio leave it, and the call (ВЫЗ) brings them back. Which seat holds A-2 to A-5 on the Osa is not documented: A-2 the deputy commander (the ZSU-23-4 analogue, tpu_zsu; the NVA's deputy with the lock-on button), the rest by seat. A-2 and the driver's ПВ reach the left set (SAM3D's choice).

beams.source: flak11 and korovin_tiv_2010 (33 rpm; the beam is switched to one of three positions each turn); samsim_osa p15 (selector: ЛУЧ I, II, III, АВТ. I-III, АВТ. I-II); mon_2112_80 p15, p21
beams.notes: Positions of soc.beam: I, II, III hold one beam; АВТ. I-III steps through all three, one per turn, and АВТ. I-II through the lower two. The rings are the ePap rings (samsim_thread): the 0-15 km scale has them at 2, 7 and 12 km, the others every 5 km from the origin (SAM3D reads that as multiples of 5 km inside the window).

iff.source: mon_2112_80 p21 (general interrogation ЗАПРОС and ЗАПРОС К: the reply is a 20° arc on the PPI; or the gated mode, where the search echo gates the reply and the mark is much narrower), p14 (the interrogator NRZ's antenna is built into the search antenna); voenizdat_osa_1991 p17 (a reply puts a «свой» mark beside the echo), p55 (ЗАПРОС К is a control interrogation confirming a friend), p53 (identification range at least 30 km, 1L24-2), p56 (1 s per press)
iff.notes: The interrogator works with the search radar radiating (SAM3D). Range and query time are the 1991 textbook's for the AKM's 1L24-2; the Osa-AK's interrogator may differ. Gated mode: КЛАПАН.

search.notes: Scales p15 item 5; СДЦ works to 35 km, p15 item 12.

elevation_search.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p95 (in ЦУ the SSC antenna searches in elevation within the search beam the target was detected in; the OS81-10M auto-capture circuit, armed by ЦУ and АЗ, fires when the target is in the antenna's beam and the range gate is on it), p86 (the scan comes from self-oscillation of the elevation drive; beam commands I, II, III from the search radar), Fig. 2.37 p97 (beam I −1° to 5°, II 3° to 9°, III 6° to 30°); korovin_tiv_2010 (tracking beam 1°)
elevation_search.notes: Scan period: SAM3D estimate. In the automatic beam programmes (АВТ. I–III, I–II) SAM3D searches the beam the search radar sees the target in nearest the azimuth line (the real scan follows the search radar's beam commands). mon_2112_80 p21 gives I–II as 0–8° and I–III as 0–28°: the textbook's figure is used.

track.notes: SSC displayed range 28 km (p16); ±330° azimuth (p14, p16; voenizdat_osa_1991 p66; mon_2112_80 p25 gives ±342° for the turret). TV fields 00-60 x 00-80 (3.6 x 4.8°) wide and 00-18 x 00-24 (1.08 x 1.44°) narrow (voenizdat_osa_1991 p101; an operator on samsim_thread gives the same); the larger figure is used. SAM Simulator's manual gives 5° / 1.5°. fov_height_ratio 0.75 is the height over the width of those fields (00-60 over 00-80), used for the lens field in manual TV tracking.

orientation.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p48 (gyro half-compass GA-3 measures the vehicle's heading Qc once oriented; the Qc found with an artillery compass and the TV sight by mutual sighting is set on the setter ЗК-4; with АК — ЗК at ЗК and РЕЛЕ — Qc at Qc the setter is connected and the correction motor turns the GA-3; СОГЛАСОВАНИЕ speeds it up; agreement is checked on the Qc scale of OR-31M, which stops), p50–52 (block 0005-8M), p246 (the deputy crew chief orients the vehicle at a halt), p249 (Qc: clockwise from north to the vehicle's axis); mon_2112_80 pp. 63–68 (orientation is lost when the equipment is switched off)
orientation.notes: Rates are SAM3D estimates. The GA-3 runs on vehicle power (SAM3D); without it, the frame starts again taking the hull to face north. Holding СОГЛАСОВАНИЕ is one press in SAM3D: the fast turn continues until the scales agree. Drift (simcore/orientation.hpp): the Earth's rate 15.041 deg/h times sin(latitude) is textbook physics of the directional gyro; the latitude correction (p51: ШИРОТА potentiometer, used with РЕЛЕ — Qc at РЕЛЕ once oriented, p48) cancels the part set on its scale. own_drift_deg_h 0.5 is a SAM3D estimate: no source gives the GA-3's own drift, and this is of the order of a directional gyro of the period, so an hour or two shows it (its sign is drawn per run). The crew chief's compass work (p249-250: the ПАБ 20-50 m ahead, the launcher laid on it with the TV sight, mutual sighting, the compass correction, Qc = α − qв): survey_s 180 and survey_sigma_deg 0.2 (about 0-03) are SAM3D estimates.

procedures.source: r123m_training (the order of work: ФИКСИР. procedures.notes: Driver, at a halt, with the set on and warm, in СИМПЛЕКС. The frequency plan is the scenario's (c2 presets); the frequency and antenna knobs are wheel work described in the steps (an NPC turns them). The driver keys the set with his chest switch, his ПВ on РС.

Open the cover over the frequency fixators
ФИКСИР. ЧАСТОТЫ 1: wait until УСТАНОВКА ЧАСТОТЫ and НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ stop turning
Unlock fixator 1 with the key; set its frequency with УСТАНОВКА ЧАСТОТЫ and ПОДДИАПАЗОН to its sub-band
Lock fixator 1: the slot on the drum's red circle
Chest switch to ПРД
Unlock НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ (3-4 turns) and tune it to the meter's peak
The lamp at its brightest: lock НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ
Release the chest switch (check the modulation: раз, два, три)
ФИКСИР. ЧАСТОТЫ 2: wait until УСТАНОВКА ЧАСТОТЫ and НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ stop turning
Unlock fixator 2 with the key; set its frequency with УСТАНОВКА ЧАСТОТЫ and ПОДДИАПАЗОН to its sub-band
Lock fixator 2: the slot on the drum's red circle
Chest switch to ПРД
Unlock НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ (3-4 turns) and tune it to the meter's peak
The lamp at its brightest: lock НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ
Release the chest switch (check the modulation: раз, два, три)
ФИКСИР. ЧАСТОТЫ 3: wait until УСТАНОВКА ЧАСТОТЫ and НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ stop turning
Unlock fixator 3 with the key; set its frequency with УСТАНОВКА ЧАСТОТЫ and ПОДДИАПАЗОН to its sub-band
Lock fixator 3: the slot on the drum's red circle
Chest switch to ПРД
Unlock НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ (3-4 turns) and tune it to the meter's peak
The lamp at its brightest: lock НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ
Release the chest switch (check the modulation: раз, два, три)
ФИКСИР. ЧАСТОТЫ 4: wait until УСТАНОВКА ЧАСТОТЫ and НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ stop turning

The lamp at its brightest: lock НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ

Lock fixator 4: the slot on the drum's red circle
Chest switch to ПРД
Unlock НАСТРОЙКА АНТЕННЫ (3-4 turns) and tune it to the meter's peak

procedures.name: Autonomous target acquisition with the SOC radar
procedures.source: samsim_osa p21–24; seats: flak11 (9A33-3)
procedures.notes: Senior operator: find the target and put the SSC azimuth line on it. Several steps wait for target geometry (50, 35 km) that the sim provides later; those waits are in the descriptions. The same order goes with ready_capture (deputy commander) and capture_with_ssc (operator). The manual then selects the beam the echo appeared in; SAM3D's crew leaves АВТ. I–III on, where target designation searches the beam the echo is seen in. SAM Simulator has the crew watch the PU-12's plotting board; the board is in the battery's post, and the vehicle gets the target by voice from the battery commander, azimuth and range (flak11), so the cue here is his designation.

procedures.source: samsim_osa p34 and samsim_thread (ПОМЕХА: method Н against a jammer, the fuse armed with the medium beam because there is no range); korovin_tiv_2010 PDF p24 (in heavy jamming the range is taken from the search radar); seat: flak11 (9A33-3)
procedures.notes: Deputy commander, when the tracking radar's echo is lost in the jamming and it follows the jammer in angle. The operator keeps the range wheel on the target's blip on the search scope, or on the range the battery commander gave; ЦЕЛЬ В ЗОНЕ then lights from that range. Without any range the NPC waits: firing blind is the commander's decision. The order of the steps is SAM3D's, after emcon_tv_engagement.
